name: 105 Di2 R7170
use_case: Road and all-road 2x12 electronic shifting with hydraulic disc brakes
positioning: The default value benchmark: mature parts supply, 36T cassette capacity and an HG-compatible road ecosystem.
architecture: Semi-wireless: the levers transmit wirelessly; front and rear derailleurs connect to one internal BT-DN300 battery.

weight.note: No package-independent total is used. Dealer options vary in whether crank, cassette, chain, calipers, rotors and bottom bracket are present.

battery: Internal BT-DN300 derailleur battery; wireless levers use coin cells.
controls_and_app: E-TUBE PROJECT Cyclist supports firmware, adjustment and control configuration.
package_summary: A large-set label is not normalized. The dated ¥4,150 and ¥4,200 observations say large package without rotors; a separate ¥3,570 observation covers electronic parts plus calipers.

compatibility.freehub: HG road for the supported 11T-start cassettes
compatibility.frame: Internal BT-DN300 space and two SD300 wire routes to FD/RD

china_price_status: Secondary dealer-market synthesis: ¥4,150-4,200 for large packages described without rotors; exact checkout, invoice, warranty and every included component remain unverified.
